create_SegmentationConfig: create a SegmentationConfig dataclass to configure DINOv3 backbone, decoder, optimizer, and dataset for segmentation
build_DecoderConfig: build a DecoderConfig dataclass to set decoder type, hidden dim, num classes, and dropout for segmentation head
create_OptimizerConfig: create an OptimizerConfig dataclass to set learning rate, beta1, beta2, weight decay, and gradient clipping
build_EvalConfig: build an EvalConfig dataclass to configure slide mode, crop size, stride, and test-time augmentation for evaluation
use_ModelDtype_autocast_dtype: use the ModelDtype enum autocast_dtype property to get torch bfloat16 or float32 dtype for mixed precision
